title: Dashboard reader keeps steps and readiness, and reports unknown layouts
goal: The reader sees what the owner view needs and never shows an unreadable backlog as empty
acceptance: records() keeps Priority, Remaining, Depends on, Agent, Procedures and Decisions cells and the steps table (Who, Depends on including `repo:STEP-ID`)
An unknown record heading, summary column or status is a reported problem, not a component with no work
A file over 1 MB is read through the blob API or reported; fixtures with the authored four-column layout, an unknown heading and a renamed column
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A layout the reader cannot parse is reported, never guessed

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.13.0; review, CI and tag remain. Closed 2026-11-25: released in v10.13.0 (#269 merged; main CI green on 8a54ecc confirmed before tagging).
